description:
Seo Ji-woon goes to pay his respects at the funeral of his team leader's father—who is also his boyfriend and a colleague—only to discover that he is a married man. Enraged by the fact that he was someone's lover, he resolves to find a better man; just then, he makes eye contact with his colleague Shin Jae-on… and time stops as if by magic!

[Congratulations! You two have been selected as the first pilot couple for the [Humanity Preservation Plan]!] [MISSION: Reactivate the world through physical contact with the target.]

Can't leave if I don't complete the mission? Here? At my ex-boyfriend's father's funeral?! More importantly, we… are both men…!!
